name: quire
description: One file for a job application: CV, criteria response and cover letter, edited in the finished design and printed to PDF.

scripts.check: npm run fonts && vite build --outDir build --emptyOutDir && cmp -s build/index.html dist/index.html && echo 'dist is current' || (echo 'dist differs from a fresh build: run npm run build' && exit 1)
scripts.test: npm run fonts && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run check && npm run test:e2e
